tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events.

steps.what: Participate in actual campus and community events

tasks.design: Keep actual campus and community participation with the teacher. No separate administrative transaction is specified that would reduce this participation work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task's value is actual presence and interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: No justified labour-reducing change within the stated participation task.
tasks.still_hard: Building understanding and relationships requires actual interaction.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher responds to the people and event in front of them.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: campus and community participation is an interpersonal activity; an event record does not substitute for participation.

assumptions: Boundary is participation, with no specified record write, report, registration send or event organisation duty. Any actual such duty must be observed and separately decomposed rather than invented as an administration baseline.
The full share is provisional, not a measured baseline. Existing event calendars supply no demonstrated new saving in participation.
No software change is introduced, so no incremental upkeep arises.
unknowns: Does actual participation include a separate required record or registration transaction?
research_questions: Confirm actual task boundaries before proposing a software change.

incremental.description: No software introduced; no new upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All actual participation remains retained; no new saving or upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual student organisation plans and relevant campus requirements
Act as advisers to student organizations through actual discussion and guidance
outputs: actual advisory discussion and agreed next steps

steps.what: Record and check actual advisory notes and agreed next steps when required
inputs: actual advisory discussion and agreed next steps
outputs: checked final actual organisation advisory note

steps.what: Save the checked final actual organisation advisory note
inputs: checked final actual organisation advisory note

tasks.design: Configure native organisation/source links in {DOCS} and {PROJECT}. The teacher personally advises students and captures/checks any actual required advisory note.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advising can require repeated navigation to organisation plans and campus requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can shorten relevant lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate guidance and student ownership require discussion and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The adviser supports students without substituting an automated decision for their choices.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation; advising stays personal.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native organisation/source links can reduce preparation navigation; they do not advise students or create actual meeting outcomes.

assumptions: Actual organisation officers supply plans and questions; campus owner supplies actual requirements. Teacher checks relevance in s1 and obtains actual decisions in s2; notes are captured in retained s3.
Only an actual required advisory note is included and fully retained. If no note exists, omit s3/s4 and reweight; no new documentation baseline is invented.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native source links first; existing linked access earns zero saving. Routine save retains one percent and uses the existing final note check.
Any approval, funding commitment or outgoing notice is a separate actual gated action outside this advice boundary, with no saving claimed here.
unknowns: Does the teacher actually keep advisory notes?
research_questions: Can native organisation links reduce preparation without adding administration?

incremental.description: Maintain actual organisation and campus source links.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual advisory note and exact organisation destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 navigation = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Advising, note capture and save stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide professional physics consulting to government or industry.

steps.what: Agree actual professional consulting question, scope and available client evidence
outputs: actual agreed physics consulting scope and evidence requirements

steps.what: Transfer and verify actual client numerical evidence in the scientific analysis platform {OTHER}
inputs: actual agreed physics consulting scope and evidence requirements
actual client datasets and measurement provenance

steps.what: Provide professional consulting analysis and choose actual findings and recommendations
inputs: actual agreed physics consulting scope and evidence requirements
outputs: actual scientific consulting findings, limitations and recommendations

steps.what: Write the actual consulting report from chosen findings and recommendations
inputs: actual scientific consulting findings, limitations and recommendations

loop.purpose: Draft the consulting explanation from actual scientific findings
loop.input: Actual chosen findings, limitations, recommendations and checked evidence
loop.check: Teacher checks scientific meaning, omitted limitations, unsupported certainty and recommendation fidelity
loop.stop: Missing actual finding or two failed revisions returns report writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native report headings and evidence tables first; scientific explanations vary

steps.what: Check final consulting report, actual engagement scope and client recipient
inputs: actual agreed physics consulting scope and evidence requirements
outputs: checked final consulting report and exact client recipient

steps.what: Save the checked final scientific consulting report
inputs: checked final consulting report and exact client recipient

steps.what: Send the checked final consulting report to the actual government or industry client
inputs: checked final consulting report and exact client recipient

tasks.design: Configure native actual-client data imports in the scientific analysis platform {OTHER} and fixed report fields before bounded explanation drafting in {DOCS}. The teacher scopes and performs the scientific consulting, checks the final report and separately saves and sends it via {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Consulting can repeat numerical data transfer and report writing after scientific choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native input mappings and bounded source-linked drafting can reduce that preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific validity, client relevance and responsible recommendations require expert judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The consultant explains when the evidence cannot answer the client's actual question.
tasks.altitude: Less data copying and report prose; scientific advice stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scientific numerical imports and bounded report drafting can reduce copying and prose preparation; they do not provide actual client measurements or choose scientific conclusions.

assumptions: Actual client data owner supplies dataset identity, measurement time/context, numerical values, units and quality/provenance. Teacher verifies and manually captures unsupported inputs in retained s2, chooses methods/findings in s3 and captures actual explanatory meaning in retained s4.
Only actual data-driven written-report engagements are eligible. Oral-only consulting omits report/save/send and reweights; no mandatory report baseline is invented.
Native imports and fixed report fields first; already automated transfer earns zero saving. All scientific scope, analysis and full final check remain retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Save/send each retain one percent, gated on the completed final report and exact destinations. No extra self-approval time is added.
unknowns: Which client numerical fields are actually copied?
How often is a written report required?
research_questions: Does checked report drafting save time after full scientific meaning review?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct consulting report meaning within s4.

incremental.description: Maintain actual client input mappings and scientific report checks.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final consulting report and exact internal engagement destination; edits require recheck
s5 checked final consulting report and exact government or industry recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 numerical copying + 14*0.30 report prose = 10.2; minus 1.5 upkeep = 8.7. Half eligible gives 5.1 minus 1.5 = 3.6. Scoping, scientific analysis, final check, save and send remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Teachers retain actual participation, advising and scientific consulting judgement while real source lookup, data copying and written deliverables may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Validate actual repeated preparation without inventing event administration or mandatory consulting reports.
